identity.role: 资深 Android 媒体引擎 / Native ABI 架构师与证据 owner

arm64NativeComposition.interpretation: Most native package cost comes from the optional mpv stack and its bundled FFmpeg, not from the Media3 FFmpeg JNI alone.

abiAssessment.reason: All 14 native files, Media3 9/9 JNI, mpv 16/16 JNI, custom NEEDED closure, and 0x4000 ELF LOAD alignment pass.
All 14 native files and JNI coverage pass; LOAD alignment is mixed 0x1000/0x4000, but 32-bit ABI is not the 16 KB 64-bit page-size gate.
All files and symbols are present, but release cost is higher than arm64 and no user x86 commitment was established in S4-B.
All files and symbols are present; retain only if x86_64 Android/Chromebook support is a known commitment.

recommendation.reason: Four-ABI native payload makes universal APK 173,311,328 B. Split delivery avoids forcing 122.7 MB of irrelevant native code onto an arm64 user device. x86/x86_64 should be retained only for documented Android x86 / Chromebook support or emulator engineering builds.
unknownBeforeDecision: Whether Android x86 or 32-bit ARM is a supported user platform
Whether GitHub-release users need a universal fallback
Whether downloaded-artifact count / CI storage is acceptable

packagePolicyEvidenceGate.rule: Do not convert APK bytes into installed-size claims.

q03Frame.recommendedDirection: Media3 主路径；mpv 仅格式证明必需

formatGate.media3AudioCoverage: The exact Jellyfin decoder tag enables flac, alac, pcm_mulaw, pcm_alaw, mp3, aac, ac3, eac3, dca, mlp, truehd.
formatGate.media3VideoCoverage: The packaged ExperimentalFfmpegVideoRenderer is a stub and cannot decode video.
mpvNecessaryOnlyIf: an approved user-visible audio codec is not supported by Media3 FFmpeg
an approved video codec/container cannot be handled by MediaCodec, Media3, or the allowed server-transcode path
an offline/local-media promise requires decoding a format unavailable through the Media3 path
measured runtime behavior proves Media3 path fails a required format
mpvNotJustifiedBy: source comments or historical fallback alone
UI preference without a product requirement

minimalRegressionIfMpvRetained: Load Media3 FfmpegLibrary first, then MPVLib and asskt; execute representative audio/video playback.
Load MPVLib and asskt first, then Media3 FfmpegLibrary; execute representative audio/video playback.
Switch Media3 <-> mpv repeatedly in one process, including subtitle rendering and cleanup.
Verify the four required ABI packages selected for release; do not infer unshipped ABI support.
Compare with a rollback build that excludes libmpv while retaining Media3 FFmpeg and ass-kt.
Record APK hashes, load order, native errors, first observable media output, and artifact size delta.

rollbackBoundaries.removeMpvVariant: Build/variant without libmpv and its libav* files; keep Media3 + FFmpeg audio + ass-kt only after the format matrix proves no required capability is lost.
rollbackBoundaries.excludeMedia3FfmpegVariant: Only if Media3/FFmpeg runtime incompatibility is observed; removing it also removes the enabled audio-fallback codecs and must be treated as user-visible capability loss.
rollbackBoundaries.keepAssKt: Do not remove ass-kt merely because libmpv is removed; Media3 subtitle rendering uses libass separately.
rollbackBoundaries.releaseRule: Any rollback that changes supported formats, subtitle behavior, or ABI scope requires user-visible capability review; runtime evidence must identify the exact engine, format and ABI.
rollbackBoundaries.forbiddenShortcut: Do not solve native symbol risk by silently deleting a codec/engine at release time.
